War criminals were Pakistan's agents
2015-12-05T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/letters/war-criminals-were-pakistans-agents-182491

In response to A.H. Dewan's letter "Pakistan's audacity" published in your daily on November 29, 2015, I fully agree that the recently hanged two war criminals (Mojaheed and SQ Chy) were undoubtedly Pakistan's agents. There are hundreds of Pakistani agents (both inside and outside the country) working hard to damage the image of Bangladesh in many different ways.
